description: The plot illustrates the average repetition rate across relation categories for three different data generation configurations and their corresponding overall averages. The x-axis is labeled "Relation Category" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 64, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 10. The y-axis, labeled "Average Repetition Rate," also uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.6, with tick marks spaced every 0.1 units. The "w/o DPO obo" configuration is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers; it begins at approximately 0.25 at x=0, displays sharp peaks at x=1 (0.6) and x=31 (approximately 0.62), fluctuates heavily across the axis, and ends at roughly 0.04 at x=64. The "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" configuration is shown as a solid orange line with upward-pointing triangle markers, starting near 0.13 at x=0, exhibiting prominent spikes at x=19 (0.4), x=31 (0.58), and x=47 (0.46), and concluding at approximately 0.16 at x=64. The "DPO" configuration is depicted by a solid green line with small star markers; it starts around 0.16 at x=0, reaches a maximum of roughly 0.28 at x=1, drops to a low of approximately 0.01 at x=9, and exhibits lower amplitude fluctuations across the graph before ending near 0.08 at x=64. Additionally, three horizontal dashed lines without markers indicate the constant average values for each configuration: the "Average of w/o DPO obo" is a dashed blue line at a steady y-value of 0.163, the "Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" is a dashed orange line at 0.227, and the "Average of DPO" is a dashed green line at 0.117.
